name: ticket
description: Interactive, problem-focused ticket creation across Jira, Linear, and common Git hosts.

interface.shortDescription: Create concise tickets across issue providers.
interface.longDescription: Ticket provides a user-controlled workflow for creating concise, problem-focused tickets in Jira, Linear, GitHub, Codeberg, Forgejo, GitLab, and Gitea through remembered MCP or CLI routing, project templates, assignment, and native iteration placement.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $ticket:create to create a concise, problem-focused ticket through an available Jira, Linear, or Git-host provider.
